reconcile.note: Gill limits Romans 13's submission command to lawful magistracy, allowing resistance to rulers who defy God's law through lawless tyranny.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Should we obey human or divine law?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/law.html) (2013).

sides.snippet: But the midwives feared God, and didn't do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
